tenderSchedule.description: SELECTION OF AGENCY FOR PROVIDING NON- TECHNICAL MANPOWER SERVICES TO KSRSAC
tenderSchedule.deptName: Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms e Governance
tenderSchedule.locationName: DPAR eGOV KSRSAC Director Office Bangalore

tenderAddress.blockNumber: The Director, Karnataka State Remote Sensing Applications Centre, DPAR e Governance, Government of Karnataka, Doora Samvedi Bhavana, Major Sandeep Unnikrishnan Road, Doddabettahalli, Bengaluru-560 097

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Agency shall be registered under the Companies Act, 1956/2013, or the Societies Registration Act, 1860, or the Karnataka Co-operative Societies Act, 1959, or may be a Proprietorship Firm. The Agency shall have its registered office in Karnataka and shall have been in existence and in business for a minimum period of Five (5) years as on the date of submission of the bid

Copy of the valid Licence issued under the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 (or under the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970, which it replaced, as applicable).
Copy of a valid and active GST Registration Certificate, duly updated / reflected as current as on the date of submission of the bid.
Copy of the Agencys PAN and/or TAN Certificate, as applicable.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of PAN and or TAN Certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Copy of a valid ESI (Employees State Insurance) Registration Certificate.
Copy of a valid EPF/PF Registration Certificate.
Self-declaration on letterhead confirming no pending dues / defaults toward GST, ESI, EPF, Professional Tax or Income Tax as on the date of bid submission.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Declaration of No Pending Statutory Dues

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Valid ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System Certificate issued by a competent authority, valid as on the date of submission of the bid.
The Agency shall hold a valid Form-C Certificate issued by the Labour Department, Government of Karnataka, evidencing employment of a minimum of 100 manpower as on the date of submission of the bid.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Form C Certificate  Labour Department, GoK

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Signed and duly filled-in Performance Specifications on the bidder's official letterhead, to be uploaded on the e-Procurement portal.
Duly filled and signed Qualification Criteria/Checklist, along with the supporting documents specified in the tender document.
Tender Form and Price Schedule, duly filled-in and signed on the organisations official letterhead, to be uploaded on the e-Procurement portal.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Tender Form & Price Schedule Activity

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Duly filled and signed Supplier Details, Power of Attorney and Affidavit shall be executed on Rs.500/- stamp paper each, and the Self-Declaration shall be submitted on the bidders official letterhead

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Details of Service Provider, Power of Attorney and Affidavit/Declaration

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder / authorised representative shall have satisfactorily provided and completed similar manpower services during the last five Financial Years (2021-22 to 2025-26). Submit the duly filled and signed Performance Statement, along with supporting documents such as Work Orders and Performance / Satisfactory Completion Certificates, as specified in the tender document.
Copies of the Income Tax Returns (ITRs) for the mentioned Assessment Years, duly certified/signed by a Chartered Accountant.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Income Tax Returns (ITRs) for the preceding five Assessment Years (AY 2021-22 to 2025-26)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Audited financial statements and Profit & Loss statement for the preceding five financial years, duly signed/certified by a Chartered Accountant, along with the UDIN.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Average Annual Turnover of at least Rs. 1 Crore during the last five Financial Years (2021-22 to 2025-26)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Copies of the challans evidencing timely payment of all statutory taxes such as GST and Professional Tax for the preceding five Financial Years (2021-22 to 2025-26).
